# AI-Team — .NET Agent Toolkit

**New here? Run `/at-status` first** — it scans your project and recommends exactly which commands to use next.

## Commands

| Command | Description | When to use |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| `/at-status` | Project health diagnosis + recommended next step | Any time — orientation, daily standup |
| `/at-plan` | Spec-driven story planning → task decomposition | Before starting any new feature |
| `/at-apply` | Executes a planned task from the spec | After `/at-plan` approves a story |
| `/at-validate` | Multi-discipline review of code or spec | Before merging; after significant changes |
| `/at-arch-improve` | Detect architecture drift, propose ADRs | Monthly / after major refactors |
| `/at-context-sync` | Reconcile `CONTEXT.md` after a session | End of each coding session |
| `/at-context-grill` | Deepen project context via interview | When context is stale or incomplete |
| `/at-init-constitute` | Re-run constitution ceremony | When governance needs updating |
| `/at-meta-improve` | Improve agent skills from patterns | When a pattern recurs 3+ times |
| `/at-meta-teach` | Teach the agent a new convention | When introducing a new team rule |

## Skills (active for this stack)

| Skill | Description | Triggered by |
|-------|-------------|--------------|
| `dotnet-guardrails` | .NET 9 conventions: naming, async, EF, logging, DI | Any .NET code generation |
| `engineering-conventions` | Language-agnostic principles: error handling, observability, testing | All code tasks |
| `diagnose-project` | Detect project state, classify maturity, recommend next step | `/at-status`, `/at-plan` |
| `write-context` | Write/refresh all context artifacts | `/at-init-setup`, `/at-context-grill` |
| `write-architecture` | Write/refresh `ARCHITECTURE.md` | `/at-arch-improve`, `/at-init-constitute` |
| `write-adr` | Write a single numbered ADR to `docs/adr/` | `/at-arch-improve`, architectural decisions |
| `discipline-review` | BA / Arch / QA / Security multi-lens review | `/at-validate`, `/at-init-constitute` |
| `scaffold-dotnet-solution` | Scaffold new .NET solution from interview | `/at-init-bootstrap` |
| `sync-context` | Reconcile `CONTEXT.md` drift after session | `/at-context-sync` hook |
| `create-pr` | Generate PR title, description, and review checklist | `/at-apply` on completion |
